about: Named hashes (editor spec section 51, spec_hashes_named; requirements/hashes.md). Every hash a judgement graph holds names its algorithm, and a judgement or a serving edited after its content hash was made is reported. Both libraries run these cases: packages/graph-spec/test/hashes.test.mjs and python/graph_spec/tests/test_hashes_named.py. Each case gives the judgement graph jud, and whether each rule it names holds.

rules.named: every hash names its algorithm: sha-256-64: or sha-256: before its digits (editor spec §51)
rules.judgement: §23 rule 7: no judgement is edited — each content hash, covering its pins, still matches (rule:judgement-hash@1)
rules.serving: §24 H3 rule 5: no serving is edited — each content hash, covering what it served, still matches (rule:serving-hash@1)

cases.name: a judgement whose hashes name sha-256-64 holds
body: (t_rests:ElementType {name: 'RESTS_ON', kind: 'edge', reading: 'rests on', reverse_name: 'is the basis of'}),
(d1:Decision {id: 'decision:L1', statement: 'Write off L1', at: DATE '2026-12-14', content_hash: 'sha-256-64:57b3b7e3cf39e0ef'}),
